info.title: Pixel-Face AI Companion
info.author: SimpleApps
info.description: A pixel face that chats on the GamePad
info.details:
Pixel-Face is a little painted face living on your Wii U GamePad. It breathes, blinks, follows your finger with its eyes and moves its mouth while it answers.

Ask it anything: type on the on-screen keyboard, and the question goes to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint:  Google Gemini and OpenRouter works directly, LM Studio or Ollama in your LAN too.  The answer streams back word by word, the face picks a matching expression - happy,  surprised, sleepy, in love, annoyed.  A Mumble voice babbles along.

Features: German/English interface, context of the last questions, adjustable thinking level, token budget and temperature, voice on/off, log viewer. Settings live in pixel.cfg on the SD card and can be edited on a PC.

AI use: Mostly AI-generated. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
